assumptions.statement: Official site boundary and key-area polygons are not yet public; the package uses maintainer-registered provisional rough polygons from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All submitted boundary/key-area polygons and every area-derived metric must be recalculated when official or cleared polygons become available. Provisional geometry must not be used as an official redline, approval basis, or precise-area calculation basis.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundary file published with recorded source, version, coordinate system, and conversion method.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire, flood-control and heritage conditions are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal expresses design directions only and does not fabricate approved statutory indicators, parcel-level demolition/renovation conclusions, road alignments, or engineering feasibility. These items are pending official data and professional confirmation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official regulatory-plan conditions, road redlines, ownership, municipal, fire, and heritage data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Buildings in geometry/buildings.geojson are concept-level footprints expressing renewal intention; current building, ownership, and statutory building-scale data are not available.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm is a concept-level indicator for design discussion, not statutory building scale or floor-area control.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Current-building survey, ownership, and approved building-scale data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Annual event system, developer-community operation, scenario-open operation, and international communication mechanisms are concept suggestions for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: No event, investment, funding, or policy arrangement is presented as a confirmed government decision or approved implementation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Operator and government confirmation of any mechanism.
